# Homent

> Thoughtful residential cleaning for busy households that value care, consistency and attention to detail.

Homent provides residential cleaning services for homes and apartments in Johannesburg and surrounding service areas. The website explains available services, areas served and how to request a personalised quotation.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Homent overview, services and enquiry options.
- [Services](/services): Residential cleaning services.
- [Locations](/locations): Current service-area information.
- [About](/about): Information about Homent.
- [FAQs](/faq): Customer questions about services, quotations, bookings, access, cancellations, payments and service concerns.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact details and enquiry options.
- [Request a Quote](/quote): Residential cleaning quote request form.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Search-engine sitemap.

## Contact

- Website: https://www.homent.co.za
- Quote enquiries: quotes@homent.co.za
- General enquiries: info@homent.co.za
